description: AstroPulse Systems is an offline-first bio-telemetry cockpit and autonomous edge ML clinical resilience engine built for astronauts during Artemis and Mars transit. It features on-device Isolation Forest anomaly detection, adaptive crew baselines, dynamic closed-loop SOP recovery, and delayed blackbox downlink.
summary:
During deep-space missions such as Artemis lunar transits or crewed Mars expeditions, communication latency between spacecraft and Earth spans 5 to 22 minutes one-way (up to 44 minutes round-trip). When an astronaut experiences an acute medical emergency—such as rapid cabin hypoxemic decompression, hypercapnia from ECLSS CO2 scrubber saturation, or microgravity cardiovascular deconditioning—waiting for Houston Ground Control is catastrophic, and cloud-based AI fails without internet connectivity.

AstroPulse Systems addresses this challenge by providing an offline-first, edge-native bio-telemetry cockpit that runs directly on spacecraft hardware. It continuously streams 1Hz multi-vector astronaut vitals, executes dual-layer anomaly detection (combining deterministic NASA-STD-3001 clinical rules with an on-device IsolationForest machine learning model), and adapts to personalized astronaut hemodynamic baselines. When a crisis occurs, the system delivers interactive NASA Flight Medicine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and initiates an automated 15-second closed-loop physiological stabilization cycle. It also tracks 30-day microgravity bone mineral density loss, cosmic radiation dosimetry, and maintains a 1-hour blackbox buffer for delayed burst downlinks to Earth.
details:
LIVE INTERACTIVE COCKPIT DEMO: https://frontend-alpha-pied-13.vercel.app

GITHUB SOURCE CODE: https://github.com/fokrulanthro16-eng/astropulse-systems

DEMO VIDEO WALKTHROUGH: https://youtu.be/062MgB7htsk

1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

AstroPulse Systems is an autonomous, zero-cloud bio-telemetry and clinical decision-support cockpit engineered for deep-space crews operating under severe communication blackouts and latency.

- Dual-Layer Edge Anomaly Detection: Layer 1 applies deterministic NASA-STD-3001 limits and rolling dynamic Z-scores (sigma deviations). Layer 2 runs an on-device Scikit-Learn IsolationForest unsupervised ML model across 6 biometric vectors (Heart Rate, SpO2, HRV RMSSD, Respiration Rate, Core Temp, Cabin CO2) to compute a real-time Anomaly Confidence Score (0-100%) and isolate the primary failure vector locally.

- Personalized Astronaut Hemodynamic Envelopes: Dynamically calibrates physiological bounds per crew member (Commander Sarah Vance, EVA Specialist Mark Chen with athletic bradycardia baseline, and Medical Officer Elena Rostova).

- Dynamic Closed-Loop Clinical Recovery: When an emergency triggers, an interactive NASA Flight Medicine SOP Drawer guides the crew through 4 critical countermeasures (O2 mask delivery, ECLSS valve override, IV saline infusion, supine positioning). Once verified, the system engages an autonomous 15-second closed-loop physiological stabilization trajectory.

- 30-Day Microgravity Degradation & Radiation Surveillance: Tracks osteopenia/Bone Mineral Density (BMD) resorption (-1.2%/month vs. ARED resistive exercise preservation) and Galactic Cosmic Ray (GCR) cumulative radiation dose (0.82 mSv/day against NASA's 600 mSv career limit).

- Delayed Burst Blackbox Downlink & Hardware API: Maintains a 1-hour circular buffer for JSON/CSV burst exports when Earth comm links open, alongside a POST /api/vitals/ingest endpoint for wearable sensor integration.

2. BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

Empowers astronauts to autonomously diagnose, triage, and stabilize life-threatening medical and environmental crises in deep space without relying on Earth-based flight surgeons or cloud connectivity.

3. TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Backend & Edge ML: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Async WebSockets, Scikit-Learn (IsolationForest), NumPy, Uvicorn.

- Frontend Cockpit: Next.js 16 (React 19), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts (1Hz real-time telemetry waves), Lucide React, Web Audio API Synthesizer (zero-latency acoustic alarms), Vercel (Standalone Edge Fallback Engine).

- Presentation & Testing: Playwright, FFmpeg, edge-tts (neural voiceover synthesis).

4. CREATIVE DESIGN FACTORS

Built around aerospace "Grandma Theory" high-contrast legibility so an astronaut experiencing hypoxia or vision impairment can read alerts and execute SOP checklists effortlessly.
